title: Sand Art
description: A falling-sand cellular automaton. One to six spouts pour streams of colour-cycling sand that fall, pile up at their angle of repose, and settle into banded dunes — a single spout sweeps to lay the horizontal layers of a sand-art bottle, several fixed faucets build a row of banded cones. Each grain is a cell — it drops straight down if it can, otherwise tumbles diagonally, gated by a looseness so piles hold a slope; a slow floor drain keeps the sand flowing so layers build, slump and restack forever. Drop in an obstacle set — a catching Bowl, a Funnel, an Hourglass or a field of Pegs — and the sand pools, spills and streams around it. The sand gradient picks the palette (Rainbow, Sunset, Ocean, Earth, Candy or Mono) with adjustable band count. Drag to pour your own; grain size, faucets, pour rate, looseness, gradient, colour cycling, obstacles and drain are live and audio-mappable (louder pours more).
